player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw ya anggad playing ed Countdown numbers a laro!
Say layup: Say kombinen yo numero gamen na +, -, *, / ed umasik yo say pangipatan.
Say pormat na aksyon: [i j op] no diad indices so i,j tan operasyon so op.
Halimbawa: [0 2 *] ya anggad multiplika numero ed index 0 tan numero ed index 2.
Say division ya kailangan a resulta ed buo numero la.

Say kasalanan na puntos na panagduruman: {progress}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Saray indehes ya aliwan balido. Nepeg a duma tan walad range 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Aliwan dugan operasyon (pambilay ed resulta na zero odino aliwan integer)
